description:
How many hot days (30, 35, 40°C), hot nights, longest heatwave run and frosty days each suburb had in every year from 2016 to 2025, with the hottest day and coldest night. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: About 15,300 suburbs and localities; calendar years 2016-2025. Current to 2025-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/heat-and-extremes`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: days_over_30c, days_over_35c, days_over_40c, longest_hot_spell_days, hottest_day_c, hot_day_threshold_p99_c, nights_over_20c, nights_over_25c, frost_days, hard_frost_days, coldest_night_c. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_environment_heat_and_extremes
